fusions.name: Hurled Guard
fusions.desc: Hurls a hard-edged blow at a target up to 6 tiles away for 12 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, and knocks it back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Wing Flare
fusions.desc: Flares both wings, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Hold the Line
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Braced Calm
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your armour rises by 12%.
